design_detail: NESARC (2001–2002), US adults; survival analysis of time from first use to DSM-IV dependence for nicotine, alcohol, cannabis and cocaine.
can_establish: Lifetime cumulative probability of transition to dependence among ever-users, and its predictors.
cannot_establish: Figures for amphetamines (not analysed); current-era risk.

analysis.effect_sizes: Lifetime cumulative probability: nicotine about 68%, alcohol about 23%, cocaine about 21%, cannabis about 9% ([to be extracted from PDF] exact, Table [to be extracted from PDF]).

replication.where_it_stands: Consistent in ranking with Anthony et al. (1994).
